definitions.explanation: The management and movement of goods, including transportation, warehousing, and delivery systems.

examples.japanese: {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a logistics center.

examples.japanese: {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効率化|こうりつか}→効率化：07565_kouritsuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Improving logistics efficiency has become an issue.

examples.japanese: {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked a logistics company to deliver the package.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネットショッピング→ネットショッピング：29757_nettoshoppingu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦{不足|ぶそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: With the increase in online shopping, the logistics industry is facing a serious labor shortage.

notes:
{物流|ぶつりゅう} covers the entire process of moving goods — transportation, warehousing, packaging, and delivery. Short for {物的|ぶってき}⟦{流通|りゅうつう}→流通：05138_ryuutsuu⟧ (physical distribution).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: logistics/distribution center
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧: logistics costs
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: logistics company
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: logistics industry
- {物流|ぶつりゅう}⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧: logistics warehouse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{流通|りゅうつう}→流通：05138_ryuutsuu⟧: distribution (broader, includes commercial flow)
- ⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧: delivery (the final stage)
- ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧: transport (the movement itself)
- ロジスティクス: logistics (English loanword, used in business contexts)

USAGE:
A key term in business Japanese. The {物流|ぶつりゅう} sector has been in the news due to labor shortages caused by the growth of e-commerce.
